verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents headless control through an official CLI (pspace), a Core RESTful API, a JavaScript SDK, and team-scoped API keys. Machines can be created through the API or CLI, and Workflows automate ML pipelines in code, which together support non-interactive automation. missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or a non-interactive auth guide), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI/API automation.
